description: This file contains unit tests for the OnboardingStateStore component of an iOS app, verifying its behavior in various onboarding and connection scenarios.

classes.name: OnboardingStateStoreTests
classes.description: A suite of test cases for verifying onboarding state-related functionalities in the app.

methods.name: shouldPresentWhenFreshAndDisconnected
methods.description: Tests that onboarding should be presented when the application is freshly launched and disconnected.

methods.name: doesNotPresentWhenConnected
methods.description: Tests that onboarding is not presented when the app is connected.

methods.name: markCompletedPersistsMode
methods.description: Verifies that marking onboarding as completed persists the mode and prevents onboarding presentation.

methods.name: firstRunIntroDefaultsToVisibleThenPersists
methods.description: Checks that the first run introduction is initially visible and then marked as seen.

methods.name: resetClearsCompletionAndIntroSeen
methods.description: Ensures that resetting the onboarding state clears completion flags and intro seen status.

methods.name: makeDefaults
methods.description: Creates and returns a test-specific UserDefaults instance for the tests.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the user defaults by removing persistent data for the test suite.
